propositions: Before extracting shared units from adapters/jira/, exact-value characterization tests must pin the current behavior of all units being moved to prevent silent mapping changes passing CI.
The existing test_backend_contract.py cannot detect Jira-specific mapping regressions because it is deliberately written to be backend-agnostic, so a dedicated characterization oracle is required.

All value maps (status, priority, relation-to-link, identity format) must have assertions for every key AND for unmapped keys hitting documented defaults, since defaults are the branch most likely to be dropped during extraction.
Mutation testing of at least three pinned units must demonstrate that altering source values causes corresponding characterization test failures, proving the oracle actually gates behavior changes.
The characterization suite must cover all branches of map_fields_to_remote and classify_probe_response with exact detail dicts to catch any behavioral drift during the DC work's unit relocation.
